11 September 11 Sep
Vercel Sandbox now provides 64 GB of storage
Vercel Sandbox now provides 64 GB of storage per sandbox, up from 32 GB, by default on the latest SDK and CLI versions and when created with an image.
Andy Waller, Luke Phillips-Sheard
10 September 10 Sep
GitHub Copilot is now available in the AI SDK harness layer
GitHub Copilot now runs through the AI SDK harness layer via @ai-sdk/harness-github-copilot, using the same HarnessAgent interface as every other supported harness.
Felix Arntz Software Engineer
FastAPI frontends and static files served from the CDN
FastAPI frontends and static files are now promoted to the Vercel CDN at build time and served without invoking your Vercel Function.
Daniel Park Software Engineer
Build with OpenAI Agents API on Vercel
Build and deploy an OpenAI Agents API app on Vercel with Next.js, Functions, Queues, and Sandbox for isolated, persistent code execution.
Anshuman Bhardwaj, Allen Zhou
Tako Search is free on AI Gateway through September 30
Tako Search search tool is live on AI Gateway and provides live web search for any AI Gateway model. The tool is free through September 30th.
Walter Korman, Zachary Chen, and 1 other
Vercel Sandbox is now available in all regions
Vercel Sandbox now runs in all Vercel compute regions. Choose a region per sandbox, set a project default, and configure failover regions.
Marc Codina Segura, Rob Herley
9 September 9 Sep
Password Protection is now available per project on Pro
Password Protection is now $20 per month per protected project on Pro. Enterprise includes it at the team level.
+2
Kit Foster, Caleb Boyd, and 2 others
Protect production deployments for free on every plan
You can now use Vercel Authentication to protect production domains at no additional cost. When enabled, visitors must sign in to Vercel and have access to the project before they can open a protected deployment.
+2
Kit Foster, Caleb Boyd, and 2 others
